texts.zh: 打造巨型艺术设施的第一步就要同时面临两个困难：修建一个巨大到能容纳一个错综复杂的展览馆的空间站与组织一场空前规模的展览会。当所有基本设施都准备完全时，修建保险库将成为第一要务。保险库必须足够安全以及牢固，专门用来保护这星系之中的艺术财富。
texts.en: The first stage of constructing a Mega Art Installation combined the difficulties of building a vast station with the complexities of organizing a museum and gallery on an unprecedented scale. With the basic structure in place, the Vault will be the top priority. Planned to be a marvel of security and stability, the Vault will contain and protect the artistic wealth of the galaxy.
